nom: Avène Tolerance Extremely Gentle Cleanser Lotion

segments.oily: Reports from oily skin are mixed: one reviewer says her skin felt less oily and calmer after switching to it, while others with very oily, blackhead-prone skin say it doesn't clean oilier areas like the nose thoroughly enough.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, several of whom are also acne-prone or reactive, describe it as gentle enough not to irritate, though one found it too gentle to leave a deep-clean feeling.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin mostly report it cleans without stripping or leaving skin tight, though two reviewers say it left their skin feeling more dry after use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive skin is by far the most represented group, with reviewers — including those with rosacea, eczema or hypersensitive reactive skin — repeatedly saying it calms and cleans without stinging or triggering redness; one reviewer with sensitive skin reports the opposite, that it turned her face red all over.
segments.mature: The couple of reviewers with mature or aging, sun-damaged skin — one also dealing with rosacea flushing — say it calmed their skin quickly and became part of a routine that finally worked.

concerns.redness: Many reviewers with rosacea or redness-prone skin say visible redness and flushing calm down, in some cases quickly, after switching to this cleanser; one reviewer reports the opposite reaction, that her skin turned red all over after use.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers say it helped repair a skin barrier they describe as damaged from other products or over-cleansing, with less stinging and visible healing within one to two weeks.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including those with dry or dehydrated skin, say it cleans without drying out or tightening their skin, and some describe it as actively hydrating; dissent includes two critical reviews saying it left skin feeling more dry, and one reviewer who found it not hydrating enough on its own without a moisturizer.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including those who are acne-prone, report no new breakouts, with some describing existing breakouts settling down or stopping after a short adjustment period; dissent includes one reviewer who developed closed comedones after about a week and others with very oily, blackhead-prone skin who say residue builds up in harder-to-clean areas like the nose.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer says her skin became less oily and calmer after switching to this cleanser, while others with very oily skin say it doesn't clear oil and blackhead buildup from harder areas thoroughly enough; another notes it avoids leaving skin feeling either too oily or too dry.

aspects.libelle: Doesn't remove makeup well on its own
Thin, lotion-like texture with no lather
A little goes a long way once you learn the dose

extraits.texte: I bought this today at the store and i got it because it say it is extremely gentle and for sensitive reactive skin. But when i washed my face with it, my skin was all red everywhere..i was very surprised! I wouldn't recommend if you are really sensitive or have sensitive skin! But that is just my experience with this.

I tried a new face serum which destroyed my skin, leaving it red and stinging. I needed something more soothing so I tried this cleanser. It felt like i was rubbing in lotion and didnt feel clean when i tissued it off. I ended up rinsing if off. It left a film but skin felt hydrated. To remove makeup, i found that if i used a wet soft washcloth to remove , it would take off my light makeup. My face started to heal and was less oily. Unfortunately after a week i noticed closed comedones popping up. Probably from the residue left on my skin despite rinsing well. It was hydrating for me but also very comedogenic as well. So on to search for another gentle cleanser.
Pros: no scent, feels nice Cons: my skin felt extremely dry after use

extraits.titre: Good, but not for my skin
extraits.texte: This cleanser I have used for a year and a half, and it cleanses the easy surface areas on your face very well without stripping the skin. Like forehead, cheeks, etc. But it does not do well cleaning the harder areas even when double cleansing, like the nose. My nose personally clogs up a lot because I am very oily and have many blackheads, but if thats not a problem for you I say you would like this product. (Also there is no fragrance lol)

extraits.titre: The only thing that didnt make my face burn
extraits.texte: I'm pretty sure that i damaged my skin barrier completely by constantly trying new skin care products ugh... It got to the point that it looked like i had hives all over my face from how irritated my skin got after cleansing with my usual daily cleanser. I switched out to the sensitive cleansers from cetaphil to cerave and neither worked even vanicream that is said to be for extremely sensitive skin burned. Then i was recommended this one and it really is the only thing that helped my skin T_T It is light enough to not irritate my face but also leaves it quite soft after using i would definitely recommend. Now i just need to find a good moisturizer... I have combination skin btw but now its leaning more to dry

This is the best face cleanser I've used!! I bought the hypersensitive kit and this was my favorite product in it! I have very sensitive redness-prone skin and this cleanser seems to even calm down my redness. It doesn't dry out skin at all and sometimes I don't even feel like using moisturizer after using it because my skin feels SO nice and hydrated. I will say it doesn't clean makeup off that well but I easily use micellar water before this cleanser and this product removes any remnants, plus provides that extra hydration after cleansing off makeup. my facial redness has improved a lot because i simplified my routine to just this and occasionally xeracalm moisturizer. also it lasts a LONG time - a little goes a long way! the itty bitty bottle from the kit lasted me like 3 months :)

I like using this cleanser to remove my sunscreen and make up. I then remove with Cotton pads. I do this twice to be sure all of the sunscreen, etc has been removed. Then I wash my face with a gentle cleanser that rinses off with water. I have mature dehydrated skin that is prone to acne. Avene cleanser does not cause any breakouts or irritation. I am very pleased with it.
